classification: Illustrative EUR scenarios, not observed prices, exchange conversions, market facts or forecasts
unit: one accepted creator-post job with three payout tranches; checks shared across tranches of that post
external_platform_revenue_share_note: Unknown Masumi/commercial distribution fee; zero is a direct-sales scenario, not a verified zero-fee claim. Sensitivity includes 5% and 10% assumed shares.
notes: All jobs incur the stated monitoring looks, setup and labor, including unsuccessful jobs; intentionally conservative, no early-success data reduction assumed.
Expected releases = success probability * three tranches. This correlates tranche outcomes for simplicity; real pilots must record per-tranche success and costs.
Extra submitted-transaction allowance is distinct from rejected local evaluations; latter do not automatically incur a chain fee. Data retries are included in monitoring-look totals.

Release fees are absorbed by the service in these scenarios, not also billed as pass-through. Funding/refund costs are passed at cost outside the service invoice; if the service sponsors them, add them once.

Payment collection assumption applies only to the service invoice. Invoice-based subscription has one fixed collection charge per agency-month. Unknown taxes, principal payment costs and actual platform fees are not quoted here.
Fixed overhead is additional to job labor and variable hosting; scenario allowance for management, sales, fixed tooling and audit/legal reserve. It is not a quote or a measured accounting P&L.
